description: A pink shirt lies on a green-covered table in front of a white backdrop, with a cup and small items off to the left. Both hands move in to pick up the shirt as a two-hand object, lift and shake it open, then lay it flat; the right hand smooths the top edge while the left hand steadies the lower side, and they fold it lengthwise into a long strip and then fold it again into a neat rectangle before releasing.
